name: Boomi API Management
description_en:
Boomi API Management covers API publishing, gateway policies, developer access and API lifecycle operations. A Boomi API Service can expose listener processes, while an API Proxy routes to an external backend through a gateway. Current documentation also includes API Control Plane and Cloud API Management as separately entitled surfaces.

This record uses the current Boomi product name while retaining the older Dell-prefixed catalog slug. It does not treat every Integration, Data Integration, Cloud APIM or agent-platform feature as an automatic entitlement of one API Management purchase.
description_zh:
Boomi API Management 覆盖 API 发布、网关策略、开发者访问及生命周期操作。Boomi API Service 可暴露监听流程，API Proxy 则通过网关路由到外部后端。当前文档还包含需分别开通的 API Control Plane 与 Cloud API Management。

档案采用当前 Boomi 产品名，保留旧的 Dell 前缀 slug。不能把 Integration、Data Integration、Cloud APIM 或代理平台的每项能力都视为一次 API Management 采购自动包含。

sections.title_en: Choose a Service or a Proxy according to the backend
sections.title_zh: 按后端选择 Service 或 Proxy
sections.en: An API Service defines REST/SOAP/OData endpoints backed by listener processes. Those processes and the API component must be deployed to the intended runtime. An API Proxy instead packages a gateway route to an external host, without requiring that host to be a Boomi process. For a proposed evaluation, expose a test order lookup and compare the authorized, missing-key and backend-error results. Creating a component is distinct from packaging, deployment and reachable DNS/TLS; this research performed none of those operations.
sections.zh: API Service 定义由监听流程支撑的 REST／SOAP／OData 端点，流程及 API 组件都需部署到目标运行时。API Proxy 则把指向外部主机的网关路由打包，无需后端是 Boomi 流程。建议评估一个测试订单查询，对比授权、缺失 key 及后端错误结果。创建组件有别于打包、部署及 DNS／TLS 可访问，本次未执行这些操作。

sections.title_en: Gateway placement and account scope are deployment decisions
sections.title_zh: 网关位置与账号范围属于部署选择
sections.en: The gateway handles routing, authentication, traffic controls and monitoring ahead of the backend. The current architecture says gateways are single-tenant within the account where installed; multiple environments can share one gateway, while strict production separation may need different gateways. Cluster support does not itself prove the chosen topology survives a node or network failure. Validate the actual gateway, environment, backend reachability and policy assignment before treating the inventory/control plane as enforcement on live traffic.
sections.zh: 网关在后端前处理路由、认证、流量控制及监控。当前架构说明网关在安装账号内为单租户，多个环境可共享一个网关；严格生产隔离可能需不同网关。支持集群本身不能证明所选拓扑能承受节点或网络失败。应核对实际网关、环境、后端可达性及策略绑定，不能把资产目录／控制面直接当成实时流量执行。

sections.title_en: A shared rule edit can affect several APIs
sections.title_zh: 共享规则编辑可能影响多个 API
sections.en: Policy templates are versioned bundles of existing rules. They reference rule definitions rather than cloning them, so editing a reused rule changes every template using it. Each rule retains execution timing. Before updating a common authentication or traffic rule, inspect referencing APIs and test an allowed request, a rejected request and a backend failure. Template versioning alone does not establish an isolated copy of every underlying rule or a verified safe rollback.
sections.zh: 策略模板是已有规则的有版本组合，以引用而非克隆方式使用规则，因此编辑共享规则会影响所有引用模板；各规则保留执行时机。修改公共认证或流量规则前，应检查引用 API，并测试允许、拒绝及后端失败请求。模板有版本，不代表每条底层规则均有隔离副本，也不代表回滚已验证安全。

sections.title_en: Cloud APIM import has explicit limits
sections.title_zh: Cloud APIM 导入有明确限制
sections.en: Cloud API Management documentation identifies its TIBCO/Mashery lineage and separate deployment types. The current Platform-import wizard accepts one REST API at a time; GraphQL, SOAP and other types are excluded from this particular import, even though other Boomi API surfaces support different protocols. Reimport requires a newer version and resets configuration. Review endpoint/method selection and compare the imported API before and after upgrade. Do not infer automatic cross-product parity from a shared login or brand.
sections.zh: Cloud API Management 文档说明其 TIBCO／Mashery 来源及独立部署类型。当前 Platform 导入向导每次接受一个 REST API，GraphQL、SOAP 等不在该导入范围，虽然其他 Boomi API 入口支持不同协议。重新导入要求有新版本，并会重置配置。应检查端点／方法选择，对比升级前后导入 API；共用登录或品牌不能证明产品间自动同等能力。

sections.title_en: Long backend work needs a deliberate response contract
sections.title_zh: 长时间后端操作需明确响应契约
sections.en: The API Service guide discourages web-server listeners longer than three minutes and describes an asynchronous return plus webhook or status polling. A 202 response is not the finished backend result. Separately, the management RESTish/SOAP APIs have a documented ten requests/second limit and return 503 on excess; that is not a universal public API gateway throughput limit. Monitor backend completion, gateway rejection and management throttling separately, and test retry effects on any state-changing request.
sections.zh: API Service 指南不建议 Web 监听流程超过三分钟，给出异步返回加 webhook 或状态轮询方式。202 响应不是最终后端结果。另有管理 RESTish／SOAP API 每秒十请求、超量返回 503 的限制，不能当成所有公网 API 网关吞吐上限。应分别监控后端完成、网关拒绝及管理限流，并测试修改状态请求的重试影响。

sections.title_en: Administrative visibility and deployment access differ
sections.title_zh: 管理可见性与部署权限不同
sections.en: API Manager, Infrastructure Manager, Administrator and Support split responsibility; Support can download gateway logs without configuration writes. Environment permissions still control deployment changes. Control Plane and Cloud APIM navigation require entitlements and distinct roles. The guide also says there is no single sign-off among the three applications. Test access with the intended operator and developer personas, including logout and log contents, rather than assuming one role or logout covers every surface.
sections.zh: API Manager、Infrastructure Manager、Administrator 与 Support 分工不同；Support 可下载网关日志而无需配置写权限，部署修改仍受环境权限约束。Control Plane 与 Cloud APIM 访问另需权限及角色。指南也说明三个应用之间没有统一登出。应以实际运维及开发者身份测试访问、登出和日志内容，不能假设一个角色或一次登出涵盖全部入口。

sections.title_en: Request an APIM-specific configuration and quote
sections.title_zh: 要求针对 APIM 配置的报价
sections.en: The APIM pricing section lists Professional, Professional Plus, Enterprise and Enterprise Plus, with sales contact rather than public numeric fees. Standard features include gateway policy control, developer portal and basic monitoring. Plus adds SaaS deployment and advanced analytics/governance; higher tiers change capacity options. Confirm API/transaction definitions, gateway deployments, environments, Control Plane/Cloud APIM entitlements and support in the order. “Unlimited” marketing does not establish a tested throughput or infrastructure budget, and general Integration editions are not the APIM quote.
sections.zh: APIM 定价部分列 Professional、Professional Plus、Enterprise、Enterprise Plus，通过销售报价，无公开数字费用。标准功能含网关策略、开发者门户及基础监控，Plus 增加 SaaS 部署及高级分析／治理，更高档改变容量选项。订单应明确 API／事务定义、网关部署、环境、Control Plane／Cloud APIM 权限及支持。“无限”营销不能证明实测吞吐或基础设施预算，通用 Integration 版本也不是 APIM 报价。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the exact gateway and product path
sections.title_zh: 评估明确网关与产品路径
sections.en: Boomi API Management merits evaluation for teams governing several APIs or exposing integration-backed services with an assigned operations owner. It is a weaker fit if an organization expects a discovery catalog alone to repair backend semantics or secure every unmanaged route. Current license terms, exact policy compatibility, failure recovery, regional purchasing, throughput and interface languages were not independently verified. No gateway, API key or production service was deployed.
sections.zh: 当团队要治理多个 API，或由明确运维负责人暴露集成服务时，可评估 Boomi API Management。若期待仅靠发现目录就修复后端语义、或保护每条未托管路由，适用性较弱。本次未独立确认许可、具体策略兼容、失败恢复、地区购买、吞吐及界面语言，也未部署网关、API key 或生产服务。
